proposals.title: Climate Change 2022: Mitigation of Climate Change — Working Group III Contribution to the Sixth Assessment Report of the IPCC (Chapter 12: Cross-sectoral Perspectives)
proposals.why: Authoritative IPCC AR6 chapter establishing CDR as a necessary element to achieve net-zero CO2 and GHG emissions globally.

proposals.title: Climate Change 2023: Synthesis Report — Summary for Policymakers
proposals.why: IPCC AR6 synthesis confirming CDR is unavoidable for net-negative CO2 and net-zero GHG emissions.

proposals.title: The State of Carbon Dioxide Removal — 2nd Edition
proposals.why: Global independent scientific assessment of CDR progress, gaps, and key indicators relative to Paris Agreement targets.

proposals.title: The carbon dioxide removal gap
proposals.why: Quantifies the gap between countries' CDR plans and what 1.5 °C scenarios require, showing current proposals fall short.

proposals.title: Governance of carbon dioxide removal: an AI-enhanced systematic map of the scientific literature
proposals.why: Systematic map of 876 CDR governance and policy documents, tracking the growing CDR literature.

proposals.title: Greenhouse Gas Removal
proposals.first_author: Royal Society and Royal Academy of Engineering
proposals.container: Royal Society and Royal Academy of Engineering
proposals.why: Landmark UK government-commissioned assessment of GGR methods, potentials, and deployment scenarios to reach net zero.

proposals.title: Negative Emissions Technologies and Reliable Sequestration: A Research Agenda
proposals.first_author: National Academies of Sciences, Engineering, and Medicine
proposals.why: US National Academies consensus report assessing benefits, risks, and scale potential of negative emissions technologies.

proposals.title: Negative emissions—Part 2: Costs, potentials and side effects
proposals.why: Foundational systematic review of costs, potentials, and side effects of the full range of negative emissions technologies.
